params.body:
The menu has seven categories in the dataset but no items yet, so every link to /kaart led to "De kaart wordt binnenkort toegevoegd." This hides the menu until it is filled and switched on, and adds icons to the home buttons.

## Menu behind a switch

- New singleton `menuSettings` with one boolean, "Toon de kaart op de site" (off by default). In the Studio, Menukaart now opens on "Kaart tonen op de site" above the categories.
- `isMenuVisible()` is true only when the switch is on and at least one category has items. Until then:
  - "de kaart" is left out of the header nav (desktop and phone);
  - a home button pointing to /kaart is not rendered;
  - the home meta description drops "en de kaart";
  - /kaart redirects to the home page (Astro static redirect, `noindex`) and is left out of the sitemap. The sitemap check runs the same GROQ query from `astro.config.ts`.
- The button field in the Studio says that a menu button only appears once the menu is switched on.

Switching it on takes a new build, like any other content change.

## Home

- The buttons get a line icon per target page (calendar for the agenda, a glass for the menu, a book for the story, a pin for contact), drawn like the menu button: 1.5 stroke, `currentColor`.
- The caption under the interior photo is removed; the alt text stays.

## Checked

- `astro build` against the live dataset (read only) and `tsc --noEmit`, both clean.
- Live data (switch absent): one button, no "de kaart" in the nav, /kaart redirects, sitemap without /kaart.
- With `isMenuVisible()` forced to true locally (not in this branch): both buttons with their icons.
- Not checked: the Studio form, which needs a login.

No content was written to Sanity.
params.title: Menu behind a Studio switch, icons on the home buttons
